findings.area_comparison_order: before=original reference pose, after=counterbalance endpoint; shrinking_area_fraction removes overlap from before area (equivalent to 1 - area(intersection)/area(before))
findings.direction_binding: plan direction_task_coefficients encode physical_translation_sign on shared left/right and front/behind axes; path checks and goal-area cases use the same coefficients and positive displacement_m magnitude
findings.reference_binding_partial_wave_note: Independent reference_binding wave g3rb20260908v (89/128 receipts at audit time) shows all 42 observed sign=-1 failures and additional sign=+1 left failures; pattern is not identical to horizontal but shares the same gate implementation

scientific_interpretation: At scale 0.5 (0.06 m), negative-sign shrinking-direction cases (right/behind for horizontal) remove 13.7-19.9% of legal goal area—just below the frozen 20% threshold—while positive-sign shrinking cases (left/front) exceed 20%. All 3072 path checks pass, so this is information-gate rejection rather than physical infeasibility. Workspace-edge clipping asymmetry under the registered counterbalance axis explains why the negative half fails while the positive half passes; this is not evidence of a sign inversion bug in the gate code.
